scientific_integrity: All infinite-size assertions follow by a self-contained case partition; finite direct enumeration up to n=6 and symbolic checks to n=14 corroborate coefficients. Publication date evidence comes from the publicly dated 2023-01-09 survey; initial journal article predates its 2024 preprint, but its first online day was not established.
scientific_limitations: Cartesian two-clique prisms only, n>=4; named-vertex functions under maximal double Roman defender convention; no extension to arbitrary products or outside audit. Historic publication priority not independently certified.
title: Complete maximal double Roman domination polynomial of two-clique prisms
